purpose: Course validation adapter. Same task, scene, controller, GR00T server and scoring as the evaluation of the course checkpoint, with these documented changes only.
changes: standing61 start-up: HOME joints locked by temporary joint limits on the measured grounded root (grounded-pose.json), free root, zero external wrench; released when the first real GR00T prediction has returned and before it is applied
scoring and task clock start at the brake release; nothing is scored while joints are locked; no release if no prediction arrives
Nav2 planner is not started (original GR00T episodes sent no planner query); a stand-in refuses any query
onboard YOLO detector session is not started (it is only queried when no walking policy server is set)
optional Isaac Sim window (--visualizer kit, default for learners)
inference server and trainer run through portable_launch.py, which rebinds the recorded base-model path to the pinned revision on the current machine
not_a_reproduction: The development 2/5 of the course checkpoint used the original start-up; results with this adapter are new experiments.
